'''Yractos''' was a locale on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a [[Thalassian/Legends|Thalassian]] [[slaver]] was arrested in Yractos, unearthing a slaving ring scandal. The findings implicated [[Senator/Legends|senators]] [[Danry Ledwellow/Legends|Danry Ledwellow]] of [[Er'Kit/Legends|Er'Kit]], [[Bufus Ritsomas]] of [[Till Chorios]], [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and [[Wuja Wojaine]] of [[Pydyr]] as having profited from [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] in their home [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].<ref name="HNNews" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yractos was first mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 50|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #50]], an article on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] website<ref name="HNNews" /> in [[2002]].<ref name="HNNews date">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>
